speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. You are here for sudden-onset lower back pain radiating down your leg; to narrow this down, is the pain sharp and shooting, or does it feel more like a dull ache? Does the pain travel all the way to your foot, and is it worse when I straighten your leg while your hip is bent?

speaker: Patient
text: 26-year-old woman. The patient reports exercising in the gym several hours ago when she suddenly felt a sharp pain in her lower back. She describes the pain as radiating down the side of her leg and into her foot.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Lumbar Radiculopathy (likely L5 or S1 nerve root compression).

Given your sudden onset of sharp, radiating pain after exercise, I want to confirm the severity. Have you experienced any numbness, weakness, or difficulty moving your foot or toes? REQUEST TEST: MRI_Lumbar_Spine; REQUEST IMAGES.
